label: Grim Dawn sandboxes
description: How Grim Dawn sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Total-conversion and content mods are folders under mods, each with its own database and resources.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
